user.title: Connect Ufanet intercom
user.description: Enter the account credentials to perform read-only discovery. No entrance is opened during setup.

acknowledge.title: Acknowledge discovered entrances
acknowledge.description: Read-only discovery found {discovered_count} entrances, {distinct_name_count} distinct names, and {duplicate_name_count} duplicate names. Before creating the entry, understand that calling button.press causes real physical actuation and opens an entrance; exposing this opening button to a remote UI, automations, or a voice assistant can also actuate it. Provider-supplied display names may be address-like and can persist in the entity registry, device registry, backups, Recorder/history, remote UI, and voice-assistant metadata. Duplicate names require careful identification. Confirm to trust all discovered bindings.

data.acknowledge: I acknowledge and trust all discovered entrance bindings

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Ufanet intercom
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current Ufanet password. No entrance is opened during reauthentication.
